scope: Independent local static sheared-pinch algebra; no production kernels, numerical spectra, global stability or physical-mass eigenpair claim.

proof.suite: Sheared pinch raw energy, static reduction and local threshold

engine_scope: 44 expressions checked independently by native FortSym and SymEngine using check_identity, with no probes. Exact full raw completion is checked directly; its minimum is then instantiated from that proved completion.
format_check: fo fmt --check on the exact proof source passed
domain: Physical radius r>0, mu0>0, real amplitudes, Bz>0, gamma*p>0, K2>0; invert tangents only for F nonzero. Simple resonance uses interior rs>0, Zs>0, A*C*m nonzero, k=-m*A/Zs, positive Bz squared and pressure on the interval. Boundary cross term must vanish. At F=0 the inverse and finite physical mass are not inferred.
draft_chart_correction: Strict checking rejected a draft that swapped eta/mu derivative groups and omitted J factors. Final source uses T*(J*eta)_theta-P*(J*eta)_zeta+P*mu_theta+T*mu_zeta, with mu=nu+J*(P/T)*eta; the existing production contract was unchanged.
